findings.reason: Restart no longer infers an unobservable prior response/acknowledgment. A complete valid frame is authoritative; callers converge by reading catalog state, while partial or invalid frames fail closed. Sync errors poison the current supervisor instance.

implementation_gates: Enforce catalog size/frame-count bounds before append and during replay.
Keep second catalog authorization before every DB/sidecar/key open and preserve required case-lock lifetime.
Test ready cleanup precondition against lesson-state mutation.
Complete platform ACL, stable identity, sync durability, and cross-process locking acceptance gates.
limitations: This PASS applies to the written design only. It does not verify catalog/supervisor implementation or filesystem behavior.
